about: What the completion gate's contents checks (tools/usd/contents.py) expect each place to hold beyond its inventory rows: the effects and motions the place must show, each need a word that some entry of its effects or motion records (data/effects; data/motion and data/motion/rigid) must have in its name and that must stand on the stage, moving for a motion, and the crop density where crops apply (the share of the place's soil tiles, meshes said soil, with a plant of its crops layer over them). A place not listed here is unknown, which blocks. Each place's `from` says where its needs were read.
from: the world 1 checklist of 2026-10-12 (every place against every layer of the paper's canonical scene): a need is a thing it marks done, or missing because the game lacked it (G), which the paper says SCORE makes

flat.from: effects D (cigarette wisp, breath); motion D (balcony door slide)

stairwell.from: effects: none expected; motion N: doors and gates stand still (G)

street.no_effects: none needed (captain, 2026-10-12): the effects track found no source of car exhaust in the street's record or concept
street.from: effects N: no car exhaust (G); motion N: the car stands still (G)

square.from: effects: none of its own (the launch's are seen through the launch); motion P: flags, banners, lanterns still (G)

launch.from: effects D (flame, pad fire, ground cloud, deluge steam, plume); motion P: the rocket's launch D, three ferries stand still (G)

hub.from: effects: none; motion N: hatches never move (G)

airlock.from: effects D (pump-down fog, door vent) and N: no dust when the outer door opens; motion D (doors, cycle light)

habitat.from: effects D (kettle and pot steam); motion N: doors still (G)

lab.from: effects: none counted (the glovebox's is minor); motion N: doors still (G)

workshop.no_effects: none needed (captain, 2026-10-12): the effects track found no source of sparks or soldering smoke in the workshop's record or concept
workshop.from: effects N: no sparks or soldering smoke (G); motion P: the robot's turntable D, its arms and tools and the doors still (G)

crops.why: concept K09 shows planted beds where the game drew 117 bare soil tiles; 0.9 leaves a tenth of the tiles for paths and bare ends the concept may show

greenhouse.from: effects P: humidifier mist D, no irrigation spray (G); motion N: the 16 irrigation booms stand still (G); crops N: no crop rows

garage.from: effects P: door vent and pump fog D, no wheel dust (G); motion P: the big door and beacon D, the rover, chain hoist and lift still (G)

hangar.from: effects P: venting D, no ship exhaust (G); motion P: the roof leaves D, the ship never lifts and the crane trolley stands still (G)

wreck.no_effects: none needed (captain, 2026-10-12): its concept shows no boot dust, and the effects track found no source of it
wreck.from: effects N: no boot dust (G) (the landing dust the coordinator removed is not counted: the owner never ruled); motion N: the thrower drone never flies (G)

old_station.no_effects: none needed (captain, 2026-10-12): the effects track found no source of boot dust in the old station's record or concept
old_station.from: effects N: no boot dust (G); motion: none expected
